raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred when the WebSurfer used incorrect information from an unreliable source, StatMuse via DuckDuckGo, instead of verifying the data directly with Baseball-Reference, the primary recommended source. While StatMuse indicated Roy White had the most walks, the initial accurate data needed verification on Baseball-Reference, which was not achieved due to repeated failed browsing attempts. This led to incorrect initial conclusions and persistence in using potentially inaccurate information.
